answers.core: Texture2DRD is a built in type, as are all of the RD rendering objects. To me, if it is possible for this to be done it should be a core feature.
answers.workaround: Working around this currently requires holding a copy of the texture data, and either writing to it from the compute shaders, or using a texture copy. It also requires conversion on each end so that the bits are treated correctly as uint data.

title: Allow Texture2DRD to accept 32-bit UINT types
